h: Atiku rejects Tinubu's claim that the opposition caused hunger and poverty
p: Former Vice-President Atiku Abubakar has reportedly hit back at President Tinubu, who said at his campaign flag-off that the opposition created the hunger and poverty it now campaigns against. Atiku pointed to current economic hardship under the present administration.
more: Tinubu had told supporters the opposition would not be trusted with power again.
Professor Pat Utomi separately dared Tinubu to defend his record in a live debate.
